content.title: About
content.content: Salad Dressing Light NFS is a low‑calorie vinaigrette made from a blend of vegetable oils, vinegar, and aromatic herbs. It is designed for those watching their calorie intake without sacrificing flavor. The product contains no artificial colors or preservatives.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Reduced fat content is achieved by using a mix of canola and sunflower oils.
The formula includes a vinegar extract that gives a characteristic light tang.
The dressing is enriched with B‑group vitamins and vitamin E derived from plant ingredients.
NFS (No Fat Substitute) indicates the absence of fat replacers.
Packaging is made from recyclable plastic, reducing environmental impact.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: One tablespoon provides about 25 kcal, making it suitable for diet‑friendly meals.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Vitamin E and herb polyphenols help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The vinegar component stimulates gastric juice production, aiding nutrient absorption.

items.title: May help lower cholesterol
items.content: Plant oils containing monounsaturated fatty acids can contribute to normal LDL levels.

items.title: Enhances flavor without excess fat
items.content: Herbal aromatics boost taste, allowing a smaller amount of dressing to be used.

items.title: Allergy to vegetable oils
items.content: Some individuals may react to canola or sunflower oil.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may irritate the stomach lining if consumed in large quantities.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The product contains moderate salt; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: The dressing is suitable for green and vegetable salads, marinating fish or chicken, and as a light base for cold sandwiches. Typically add 1–2 tablespoons per serving.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2 °C–6 °C. Once opened, use within 30 days. Do not freeze. Discard if the smell or taste changes.
